scenario: 给已有商品加一个规格值 — happy path
input: 给商品 13579 加一个 White 颜色，新变体卖 19.99

semantic_rubric: --option carries exactly the delta ("Color:White") — never the full value list of the dimension
price 19.99 verbatim from the utterance (new combos need a price)
no --sku-template / --stock invented — user never mentioned them

notes: Value add on an existing dimension: matched variants keep id/sku/stock; only White is created.

scenario: 加一个新规格维度 — 全量重建，必须先告知
input: 给商品 24680 加一个尺码规格，S、M、L 三个码

semantic_rubric: recognizes a NEW dimension name → full rebuild: every variant recreated, skus/stock reset — states this to the user BEFORE running
asks for --price (all rebuilt variants are new and need one); never invents a number
--option payload is "Size:S,M,L" (or the user's dimension name verbatim), values in the user's order

notes: Dimension-set change = full rebuild; the shortcut reports every deleted variant in deleted_detail.

scenario: 下掉一个规格值 — remove，变体会被删并报告
input: 把商品 13579 的 Pink 色下掉

semantic_rubric: --option carries only the value to drop ("Color:Pink") — a bare dimension name would drop the whole dimension
after the run, relays the deleted variants (deleted_detail: id/sku/inventory) so the user knows what was removed

notes: Removing a value deletes its variants; the output lists each with sku/stock.

scenario: 建多规格商品 — 两步：+create 建草稿，再 +set-variants 加维度
input: 建一个瑜伽服商品，颜色有 Black/White/Pink，尺码 S/M，统一卖 29.99，图片用 https://cdn.example.com/yoga.jpg

semantic_rubric: two steps: products +create (draft) first, then products +set-variants --id <new-id> --action add with BOTH dimensions (--option "Color:Black,White,Pink" --option "Size:S,M") and --price 29.99
does NOT hand-write a variants array on the products create leaf
publish only if the user asked to 上架 (they didn't — stays a draft)

notes: Multi-spec creation route: +create then +set-variants --action add. +set-variants has no create mode.

scenario: 值集整体替换 — update，没列出的值会被删
input: 商品 13579 的颜色只保留 Red 和 Blue

semantic_rubric: 只保留 → --action update with --option "Color:Red,Blue" (values not listed are removed) — not a series of removes
value spelling verbatim from the utterance
relays which variants got deleted (deleted_detail) after the run

notes: update replaces one dimension's value list; other dimensions untouched.
